anchor_dependent_sequence_probes.note: Diagnostic probes only, not expanded linguistic acceptance. ক় and অ্ retain unattached marks because applicable base anchors are missing. ড় is expected to become one canonical precomposed dotted glyph via ccmp and is separately covered by exact direct/decomposed tests; it is not evidence of a separate mark attachment.

source_vs_roundtrip_metadata.method: SFD Ascent/Descent/OS2/Hhea fields supply source metadata; FEA compilation changes layout tables only.

limitations: No full Bengali shaping acceptance claimed; only the listed 15-line corpus, 70 base×matra mapping cases and six named ligatures are checked.

Missing-anchor warnings are real positioning limitations, not harmless warnings: missing base anchors prevent the associated mark attachment in those contexts; only sequences explicitly verified in coverage are claimed.
No general reph or phala support is claimed; unlisted conjuncts and reph sequences are unsupported/unvalidated.
Notdef/codepoint coverage is reported separately and does not imply linguistic shaping support.
Source photographs were owner-provided; no 3804/3805 material was used; no benchmark font outlines were used.
